contract.pre_condition: self is a valid LoadedVm and state is an accepted SavedState for this destination. If state.inventory is nonempty, acceptance requires state_units.validate_inventory(&state.inventory) to return Ok. Restoring state.units requires the preconditions of state_units.restore(state.units). No compatibility check is performed here when state.inventory is empty.
contract.post_condition: At the body level, an Ok return establishes only that any required nonempty-inventory validation returned Ok and that state_units.restore(state.units).await returned Ok. The stronger caller-facing result—that every snapshot-owned component equals the projection represented by state.units and that destination-owned preparation and bindings remain unchanged—requires contracts for validate_inventory and state_units.restore.
contract.failure_condition: The function returns Err if nonempty-inventory validation fails or if state_units.restore fails. If validation fails, restore is not invoked. The body establishes no rollback, atomicity, or unchanged-state guarantee on either failure path; those properties require callee contracts.

abstraction.name: LoadedVm snapshot projection

abstract_state.snapshot_owned: The logical states of all components represented by SavedState.units.
abstract_state.compatibility_metadata: The component inventory represented by SavedState.inventory.
abstract_state.destination_owned: Destination preparation, runtime resources, host bindings, identity bindings, and other state intentionally not represented by SavedState.units.

abstraction.projection: project_saved(state) maps state.units to the logical snapshot-owned component-state map. state.inventory constrains whether that map is compatible with the destination when nonempty, but this body does not itself define either mapping.
abstraction.preserved_state: The destination-owned portion of LoadedVm, except for destination state explicitly permitted to change by the contracts of validate_inventory or state_units.restore.
abstraction.hidden_representation: state_units internals, unit lookup and ordering, serialization details, restoration staging, resource handles, caches, preparation state, and host-specific bindings are hidden.
abstraction.observation_boundary: The instant the restore future resolves to Ok and the caller regains access to &mut LoadedVm. Equality and framing are judged through subsequent caller-accessible LoadedVm and component observations, excluding transient states during await and hidden representation differences that are observationally equivalent.

implementation_assessment.claim: A nonempty inventory is checked before unit restoration.
implementation_assessment.evidence: The conditional calls validate_inventory(&state.inventory) with ? before invoking restore.

implementation_assessment.claim: An empty inventory bypasses compatibility validation.
implementation_assessment.evidence: validate_inventory is called only under !state.inventory.is_empty().

implementation_assessment.claim: Ok implies state_units.restore consumed state.units and returned Ok.
implementation_assessment.evidence: self.state_units.restore(state.units).await? precedes the final Ok(()).

implementation_assessment.claim: Successful unit restoration makes every snapshot-owned component observationally equal to the state represented by state.units.
implementation_assessment.evidence: The body delegates restoration but contains no component traversal, equality check, or post-restore validation.

implementation_assessment.claim: Destination-owned preparation and bindings are preserved.
implementation_assessment.evidence: The body has no direct assignments to such fields, but both invoked methods receive mutable access through state_units and their effects are unshown.

implementation_assessment.claim: Skipping validation for an empty inventory may admit an incompatible snapshot.
implementation_assessment.evidence: The branch demonstrably skips validation, but the meaning of an empty inventory and any compatibility checks performed by restore are not supplied.

implementation_assessment.claim: A failed restore may leave partially restored state.
implementation_assessment.evidence: There is no rollback in this body, but state_units.restore may itself be transactional.

obligations.title: Aggregate snapshot projection restoration
obligations.claim: If state_units.restore(units) returns Ok, every snapshot-owned component in the accepted unit set is present as required and observationally equals its value in project_saved(units), with no omitted, duplicated, or spuriously restored component.
obligations.why_blocking: The wrapper only propagates the callee's success and cannot establish component-wise state equality.

suggested_callees.file_hint: implementation of the state_units type used by LoadedVm
suggested_callees.reason: It consumes SavedState.units and must provide the aggregate component restoration guarantee.

obligations.title: Inventory acceptance soundness
obligations.claim: For nonempty inventory, validate_inventory returning Ok is sufficient to establish that state.units is structurally compatible with the destination unit set; separately, either an empty inventory is intentionally universally acceptable or restore performs the missing compatibility enforcement.
obligations.why_blocking: The body treats empty and nonempty inventories differently, so the accepted-snapshot domain is otherwise ambiguous.

suggested_callees.reason: Its contract must define the compatibility guarantee obtained from successful validation.

obligations.title: Destination-owned frame preservation
obligations.claim: On successful validation and restoration, validate_inventory and state_units.restore modify only snapshot-owned logical state and permitted restoration metadata; destination preparation, host resources, and destination-specific bindings remain observationally unchanged.
obligations.why_blocking: Absence of direct field assignments in this wrapper does not frame mutations performed through self.state_units.

suggested_callees.file_hint: implementation of the state_units type used by LoadedVm
suggested_callees.reason: Validation must be read-only or precisely frame any allowed mutation.

suggested_callees.file_hint: implementation of the state_units type used by LoadedVm
suggested_callees.reason: Restoration must distinguish snapshot-owned updates from preserved destination-owned state.

obligations.title: Accepted-state representation completeness
obligations.claim: SavedState.units represents exactly the snapshot-owned projection relevant to LoadedVm restore, while every excluded LoadedVm property is destination-owned or derivable and therefore intentionally framed rather than restored.
obligations.why_blocking: Even a correct state_units.restore contract cannot prove the parent claim unless the projection boundary between snapshot-owned and destination-owned state is complete and explicit.

suggested_callees.file_hint: openvmm/openvmm_core/src/worker/dispatch.rs
suggested_callees.reason: The producer of SavedState can support a save/restore projection-completeness lemma without requiring implementation-level equality.

obligations.title: Failure-state atomicity boundary
obligations.claim: Either validation and restoration failures leave the pre-restore observable state unchanged, or the API explicitly permits a partially modified LoadedVm that cannot be reused without recovery.
obligations.why_blocking: This is not needed for the success-only parent claim, but it is required for a complete safe caller-facing contract and cannot be inferred from ? propagation.

suggested_callees.file_hint: implementation of the state_units type used by LoadedVm
suggested_callees.reason: Only the restoration implementation can establish transactional rollback or characterize partial failure.

candidate_variants.name: Strong atomic projection restore
candidate_variants.semantic_difference: Ok guarantees exact observational equality for all snapshot-owned components, preservation of all destination-owned state, and Err leaves the pre-call observable state unchanged.
candidate_variants.discriminator: Inject a failure after at least one unit has been restored and compare all observable snapshot-owned and destination-owned state with the pre-call state; also compare every component after an Ok result with project_saved(state.units).

candidate_variants.name: Success-only compositional projection restore
candidate_variants.semantic_difference: Ok guarantees exact snapshot projection restoration and destination-owned framing, but Err may leave partial changes.
candidate_variants.discriminator: A successful full component comparison must pass, while an injected mid-restore failure is permitted to expose changed component state.

candidate_variants.name: Weak delegated restore
candidate_variants.semantic_difference: Ok means only that optional validation and state_units.restore returned Ok; no component-wise equality, completeness, or destination frame guarantee is promised by this wrapper.
candidate_variants.discriminator: A mock state_units implementation that returns Ok without changing unit state satisfies this variant but violates both stronger variants.

uncertainties: The concrete type and contract of state_units are not supplied.
The mapping from SavedState.units to snapshot-owned LoadedVm observations is not defined.
The semantic meaning of an empty inventory is unknown.
It is unknown whether validate_inventory is observationally pure.
It is unknown whether restore verifies compatibility independently, restores all units, permits missing or extra units, or is transactional.
The exact set of destination-owned preparation and bindings is not supplied.
No caller context defines whether observational equivalence or representation equality is required.
parsed_json.recommended_next_step: Expand O1 first by obtaining a contract for state_units.restore that quantifies over the accepted unit set and states both component-wise post-state equality and its mutation frame. Then discharge O2 and O3 to define acceptance and destination preservation; use O4 to connect that callee-level guarantee to the complete LoadedVm snapshot projection.
